Players Championship 31: Charlie Manby wins first ever PDC Ranking title and confirm Grand Slam qualification
Charlie Manby confirmed his spot in the Grand Slam of Darts with his victory at Players Championship 31; watch the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton live on Sky Sports from November 14-22
Wednesday 28 October 2026 20:17, UK
Charlie Manby stormed to his maiden PDC ranking title with a resounding 8-2 win over Maik Kuivenhoven in Wednesday's Players Championship 31.
Manby celebrated a milestone victory in the Netherlands, producing a series of dominant displays to also confirm his qualification for next month's Grand Slam of Darts.
The 21-year-old had not progressed beyond the quarter-finals of a PDC ranking event prior to Wednesday, but he reaffirmed his potential to pocket the £15,000 top prize on Dutch soil.

"It's absolutely amazing. I'm literally lost for words here," Manby said.
"There are so many good players here, so it's just crazy that I've actually done it.
"I knew I was definitely capable of doing what I did today and winning a title, but I'm over the moon.
"When I was leading against Beau [Greaves] in the semis, that's when I had a bit of nerves, especially when she started coming back!
"I was gutted to lose out in the World Youth Championship semi-finals for the Grand Slam, but I've managed to actually qualify through this which is 10 times better, so it's great."
Manby opened his campaign in style, averaging 104 in his 6-1 demolition of the Czech Republic's Karel Sedlacek, before landing back-to-back 13-darters to complete a comeback win over Dennie Olde Kalter.
The Huddersfield youngster then followed up a 6-4 success against Adam Leek with an inspired 112.16 average against Dominik Gruellich, winning each of his last four legs in 12 darts to race into the last eight.
Manby later reeled off six consecutive legs from 3-0 adrift to sink Alan Soutar, although he was forced to survive a fightback himself from Greaves to prevail 7-5 in a compelling semi-final.
This set up a winner-takes-all clash against Kuivenhoven, and Manby punished a tentative start from the Dutchman to race into a seemingly unassailable five-leg lead.
Greaves also performed magnificently at Maassport Den Bosch to climb up to seventh spot on the Players Championship rankings.
The Doncaster darter produced ton-topping averages in statement wins against Dutch duo Niels Zonneveld and Kevin Doets, launching an astonishing fightback from 5-2 down against the latter.
Earlier in the day, Spanish No 1 Cristo Reyes found a nine-darter during his opening-round drubbing of Cor Dekker - his second perfect leg in the space of three Players Championship events.
Elsewhere in Den Bosch, Nathan Aspinall was among the high-profile round one casualties, as Jermaine Wattimena, Damon Heta and Joe Cullen also bowed out at the first hurdle.

digest_he:
צ'ארלי מנבי רשם הישג מרשים כשזכה בתואר הדירוג הראשון בקריירה של ארגון ה-PDC, לאחר שגבר 2-8 בגמר טורניר Players Championship 31 על מייק קויבנהובן בהולנד. הניצחון הקנה לו את פרס ה-15 אלף ליש"ט וכרטיס כניסה לטורניר הגראנד סלאם הקרוב.

בדרך לתואר גבר השחקן הצעיר בן ה-21 על יריבים בולטים, כולל ניצחונות על קרל סדלאצ'ק ועל בו גרייבס בחצי הגמר לאחר מאבק צמוד. מנבי הביע את התרגשותו מהזכייה המפתיעה.

בטורניר נרשמו גם תוצאות בולטות נוספות, ובהן זריקה מושלמת של תשעה חצים על ידי כריסטו רייס מספרד, לצד הדחה מוקדמת של שחקנים בולטים כמו נתן אספינל וג'ו קאלן בשלב הראשון.
